d:
Shaam-e-Sher is a mushaira organized by Rekhta Foundation where some of the most talented young poets gather to enthrall you with their beautiful Urdu poetry. Some of the poets who participated are Vikas Rana, Malviya Kanha, Vipul Kumar, Ameer Imam, Rahman Musawwir, Shakeel Jamali, Saalim Saleem. The mushaira was presided by Mr. Shamim Hanfi who is a noted poet and critic.
